title: Aquarius and Aquarius Personalized Zodiac Couple Wall Art
description:
Personalized Aquarius and Aquarius zodiac couple wall art with your two names and your own short message. Our original AstroLove design joins both signs into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file, a print or a framed print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays.

Aquarius: January 20 to February 18.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors. For the digital file, choose "All 5 colors (Digital)".
3. Size: choose your size. For the digital file any size works, you receive every ratio.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print and framed print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- Your personalized design in all 5 colors
- 5 print ready PDF files, one for each color. Each file has 5 ratios: 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 11:14 and ISO A
- High resolution: 300 dpi at 16 x 20 (4:5), 18 x 24 (3:4), 24 x 36 (2:3), 11 x 14 inches and A2
- Delivered within 24 hours via Etsy Messages. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. Etsy asks for an address at checkout, but no parcel is sent. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Hahnemühle Photo Rag, 308 gsm, 100% cotton, acid-free, matte finish
- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice
Hahnemühle rates Photo Rag as museum quality (ISO 9706).

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper
Framed prints use a different paper from our unframed prints. Frames in some photos are for display. Please see the Frame Colors photo for the real frame.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
16 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 30 x 40 inches, plus A4 to A1. Every size is available as a print and in all 4 frame colors. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 5 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed and framed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders and all framed prints ship with tracking.

PACKAGING
Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope. Framed prints come in a heavy-duty box with corner guards and a protective sheet over the front.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms. Wipe the frame and acrylic with a soft, dry cloth.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print or frame arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.
Is a frame included with the Print option? No. The print comes unframed. Choose a frame option for a ready to hang piece.
How large can I print the digital file? Up to 24 x 36 inches at 300 dpi (2:3 ratio).

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Aquarius and Aquarius couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.

Aquarius: January 20 to February 18. Pisces: February 19 to March 20.

1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.

- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service

PRINT

- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper

COLORS

Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

Our original AstroLove design joins both signs into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file, a print or a framed print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays.

Aries: March 21 to April 19. Capricorn: December 22 to January 19.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors. For the digital file, choose "All 5 colors (Digital)".
3. Size: choose your size. For the digital file any size works, you receive every ratio.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print and framed print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- Your personalized design in all 5 colors
- 5 print ready PDF files, one for each color. Each file has 5 ratios: 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 11:14 and ISO A
- High resolution: 300 dpi at 16 x 20 (4:5), 18 x 24 (3:4), 24 x 36 (2:3), 11 x 14 inches and A2
- Delivered within 24 hours via Etsy Messages. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. Etsy asks for an address at checkout, but no parcel is sent. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Hahnemühle Photo Rag, 308 gsm, 100% cotton, acid-free, matte finish
- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice
Hahnemühle rates Photo Rag as museum quality (ISO 9706).

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper
Framed prints use a different paper from our unframed prints. Frames in some photos are for display. Please see the Frame Colors photo for the real frame.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
16 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 30 x 40 inches, plus A4 to A1. Every size is available as a print and in all 4 frame colors. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 5 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed and framed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders and all framed prints ship with tracking.

Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope. Framed prints come in a heavy-duty box with corner guards and a protective sheet over the front.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms. Wipe the frame and acrylic with a soft, dry cloth.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print or frame arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.
Is a frame included with the Print option? No. The print comes unframed. Choose a frame option for a ready to hang piece.
How large can I print the digital file? Up to 24 x 36 inches at 300 dpi (2:3 ratio).

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Aries and Capricorn couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.

Our original AstroLove design joins both signs into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file, a print or a framed print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays.

Aries: March 21 to April 19. Taurus: April 20 to May 20.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors. For the digital file, choose "All 5 colors (Digital)".
3. Size: choose your size. For the digital file any size works, you receive every ratio.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print and framed print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- Your personalized design in all 5 colors
- 5 print ready PDF files, one for each color. Each file has 5 ratios: 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 11:14 and ISO A
- High resolution: 300 dpi at 16 x 20 (4:5), 18 x 24 (3:4), 24 x 36 (2:3), 11 x 14 inches and A2
- Delivered within 24 hours via Etsy Messages. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. Etsy asks for an address at checkout, but no parcel is sent. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Hahnemühle Photo Rag, 308 gsm, 100% cotton, acid-free, matte finish
- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice
Hahnemühle rates Photo Rag as museum quality (ISO 9706).

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper
Framed prints use a different paper from our unframed prints. Frames in some photos are for display. Please see the Frame Colors photo for the real frame.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
16 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 30 x 40 inches, plus A4 to A1. Every size is available as a print and in all 4 frame colors. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 5 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed and framed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders and all framed prints ship with tracking.

Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope. Framed prints come in a heavy-duty box with corner guards and a protective sheet over the front.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms. Wipe the frame and acrylic with a soft, dry cloth.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print or frame arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.
Is a frame included with the Print option? No. The print comes unframed. Choose a frame option for a ready to hang piece.
How large can I print the digital file? Up to 24 x 36 inches at 300 dpi (2:3 ratio).

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Aries and Taurus couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.

Our original AstroLove design joins both signs into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file, a print or a framed print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays.

Gemini: May 21 to June 20.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors. For the digital file, choose "All 5 colors (Digital)".
3. Size: choose your size. For the digital file any size works, you receive every ratio.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print and framed print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- Your personalized design in all 5 colors
- 5 print ready PDF files, one for each color. Each file has 5 ratios: 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 11:14 and ISO A
- High resolution: 300 dpi at 16 x 20 (4:5), 18 x 24 (3:4), 24 x 36 (2:3), 11 x 14 inches and A2
- Delivered within 24 hours via Etsy Messages. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. Etsy asks for an address at checkout, but no parcel is sent. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Hahnemühle Photo Rag, 308 gsm, 100% cotton, acid-free, matte finish
- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice
Hahnemühle rates Photo Rag as museum quality (ISO 9706).

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper
Framed prints use a different paper from our unframed prints. Frames in some photos are for display. Please see the Frame Colors photo for the real frame.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
16 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 30 x 40 inches, plus A4 to A1. Every size is available as a print and in all 4 frame colors. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 5 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed and framed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders and all framed prints ship with tracking.

PACKAGING
Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope. Framed prints come in a heavy-duty box with corner guards and a protective sheet over the front.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms. Wipe the frame and acrylic with a soft, dry cloth.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print or frame arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.
Is a frame included with the Print option? No. The print comes unframed. Choose a frame option for a ready to hang piece.
How large can I print the digital file? Up to 24 x 36 inches at 300 dpi (2:3 ratio).

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Gemini and Gemini couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.

Our original AstroLove design joins both signs into one shared symbol, with your names under the two small signs. Choose a digital file, a print or a framed print. A meaningful gift for anniversaries, engagements, weddings, Valentine's Day and birthdays.

Gemini: May 21 to June 20. Virgo: August 23 to September 22.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Digital File, Print or Framed? Choose your format.
2. Primary color: choose one of 5 colors. For the digital file, choose "All 5 colors (Digital)".
3. Size: choose your size. For the digital file any size works, you receive every ratio.
4. Personalization: type the two names and your message.
Names: up to 11 letters each, printed in capitals. Message: up to 35 characters, printed as you type it. No emoji. Please check your spelling.
Message ideas: Where Our Story Began / Two Signs, One Story / Since 2019 / It Began With a Kiss in the Rain

YOUR PREVIEW
For every print and framed print, we send you a preview via Etsy Messages within 24 hours of your order. We print as soon as you approve it. If we don't hear from you within 24 hours of receiving the preview, we print the design as shown.

DIGITAL FILE
- Your personalized design in all 5 colors
- 5 print ready PDF files, one for each color. Each file has 5 ratios: 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 11:14 and ISO A
- High resolution: 300 dpi at 16 x 20 (4:5), 18 x 24 (3:4), 24 x 36 (2:3), 11 x 14 inches and A2
- Delivered within 24 hours via Etsy Messages. We check every personalization by hand before sending
- Print it at home, at a local print shop or with an online print service
- Nothing is shipped. Etsy asks for an address at checkout, but no parcel is sent. For personal use only.

PRINT
- Hahnemühle Photo Rag, 308 gsm, 100% cotton, acid-free, matte finish
- Giclée print with pigment-based archival inks
- Unframed, ready for the frame of your choice
Hahnemühle rates Photo Rag as museum quality (ISO 9706).

FRAMED
- Classic wood frame in Antique Gold, Black, White or Natural (oak effect)
- 20 mm (0.8 in) frame face, acrylic (Perspex) front, no mat
- Arrives ready to hang, hanging hardware included
- Printed on 200 gsm enhanced matte fine art paper
Framed prints use a different paper from our unframed prints. Frames in some photos are for display. Please see the Frame Colors photo for the real frame.

COLORS
See the color photo. The gold look is a printed color, not metallic foil or raised ink. Colors may vary slightly between screens and paper.

SIZES
16 sizes, from 8 x 10 to 30 x 40 inches, plus A4 to A1. Every size is available as a print and in all 4 frame colors. See the size guide photo.

PRODUCTION AND DELIVERY
- Made to order. Printed and shipped within 5 business days after you approve your preview.
- US orders are printed and framed in the US. US delivery usually takes 5 to 8 business days after shipping.
- For other countries, please see the delivery estimate for your address.
- US orders and all framed prints ship with tracking.

Prints are rolled in tissue paper and sent in a thick cardboard tube. Small prints to Europe may come in a stiff flat envelope. Framed prints come in a heavy-duty box with corner guards and a protective sheet over the front.

CHANGES
Need to change a name or the message? Just tell us before you approve your preview.

CARE
Keep away from direct sunlight and damp rooms. Wipe the frame and acrylic with a soft, dry cloth.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print or frame arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.

FAQ
Can I order the digital file and a print together? Yes. Add each one to your cart as a separate item.

THE PERFECT GIFT
A keepsake made for Gemini and Virgo couples. Short on time? Choose the digital file. It arrives within 24 hours, ready to print or share.
